title: 2400. Number of Ways to Reach a Position After Exactly k Steps

examples.explanation: We can reach position 2 from 1 in exactly 3 steps in three ways: - 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 2. - 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 2. - 1 -> 0 -> 1 -> 2. It can be proven that no other way is possible, so we return 3.
It is impossible to reach position 5 from position 2 in exactly 10 steps.
